apps.name: OpenNOW Metal 4
apps.localizedDescription: Build 190 cleans up the Standard split touchpad: removes the D-pad backing/center squares and MOVE/LOOK labels, moves Hide controls near the bottom, and leaves Show controls available after hiding, including immersive mode. Retains GeForce NOW controls/layout editing, vibration/shortcuts, Sessions history, optional HUD metrics and the upstream iOS merge. Metal 4 rendering/stutter fixes and 2560×1080 near-native MetalFX are unchanged. Device Release archive passed; 223 parity tests passed, one hardware-only skip. Unsigned IPA for KravaSigner.
